name: missionzero-middleware-proxy
description: Read-only server-side proxy between MissionZero and the iBot4CRMs middleware (Scenario 4 Digital Twin).

scripts.prod: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.live: git pull --ff-only && npm ci --omit=dev && sudo -u missionzero-proxy -H pm2 startOrRestart ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env && sudo -u missionzero-proxy -H pm2 save
